formulas.name: highlight
formulas.expression: IF( NOT( ISBLANK( {!projectId} ) ) , {!highlightProject} , "" ) + IF( NOT( ISBLANK( {!projectTaskId} ) ) , {!highlightProjectTask} , "" ) + IF( NOT( ISBLANK( {!portalTaskId} ) ) , {!highlightPortalTask} , "" ) + {!highlightUser}

formulas.name: userName
formulas.expression: IF( NOT( ISBLANK( {!$User.FirstName} ) ) , {!$User.FirstName} + " " , "" ) + IF( NOT( ISBLANK( {!$User.LastName} ) ) , {!$User.LastName} , "" )
